title: Fix x509 appendix normative contradictions and scope
description: Codereview findings (kimi-k3, 3 passes) against spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md created in viku.1. Fixes needed, all in that one file: (1) scope the MUST-conform requirement to the END-EENTITY cert only — CA/intermediate certs cannot conform (CA=true, non-Ed25519 OK per §7); (2) 'exactly one iPAddress' (§4) contradicts the permitted second link-local iPAddress — reword, and forbid a second native 0200::/8 entry, define verifier handling of a mismatched-IID link-local; (3) SAN criticality: summary table says 'critical' unconditionally and spec/06 §8.13.2 block repeats it, but §4 only mandates critical when subject is empty — align (RFC 5280: non-critical when subject non-empty); (4) worked SAN example address 0210:1112:1314:1516:1718:191a:1b1c:1d1e is non-constructible (U/L bit 0x02 set in IID byte 0; bytes 1-7 != IID bytes 0-6) — replace with a constructed example; (5) dangling refs '03-addressing.md §2' — section is 3.1; (6) validity: 396 days matches no CA/B value (398 was the BR max; SC-081 steps down further) and 'current practice' is wrong — fix the claim; (7) specify verifier rule for present-but-empty role BIT STRING (treat as unasserted); (8) add MUST-level floor on CA signature algorithm (SHA-256 class or Ed25519) — 'any widely supported' admits SHA-1; (9) drop unresolvable bead IDs (viku.7/viku.8) from spec text. Label: spec.
